The API reads request rows through absenceManagement vacationHistory/timeOffHistory. id is the integer primary key emitted as a JSON numeric value; POST creates an autoincrement key and never copies a body-supplied ID. Approved time-off rows also originate from this request table. This is a typed persistence producer boundary. Current normal request creation, updates and transition methods write status as fixed SQL literals (pending_local, preliminary_local, pending_hr, approved, rejected, withdrawn, cancelled); user input never supplies the stored status. The renderer thus receives a bounded state under these current write paths. SQL request-history JSON projects the stored value without validation, and the schema has no status CHECK: this review does not extend that claim to arbitrary modified database files or historically corrupted/imported status text.
